# Automated AI HR Screening & WhatsApp Nurturing System
> **Technical Architecture, Process Flow & Orchestration Blueprint**

---

## 📌 Metadata & System Summary

| Attribute | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Project Name** | Automated AI HR Candidate Screening & WhatsApp Nurturing |
| **System Version** | 1.2.0 (Dual Support: Local Free-Tier & Production Cloud) |
| **Orchestration Engine** | n8n (Self-Hosted / Cloud) |
| **Target Market** | Indonesia (Recruitment Operations & Talent Acquisition) |
| **Core Components** | PDF Parser, Phone Normalizer, AI Evaluator, Recruiter CRM, WhatsApp Gateway, Telegram Alert Channel |

---

## 1. Problem Context & Business Solution

### 💡 The Recruitment Bottleneck
In the Indonesian hiring market, recruitment teams routinely process **100–300 CVs per job opening**. Manual review requires **15–20 hours per week**, leading to high candidate drop-off and widespread candidate *ghosting* due to delayed feedback cycles (often 3–5 business days).

### 🎯 The Automated Process
This automated recruitment pipeline executes an immediate, multi-step screening cycle whenever a candidate submits an application:
1. **Intake & Normalization:** Ingests application data and extracts text layers from binary PDF resumes. Converts localized phone inputs into standard Indonesian international format (`+628...`).
2. **AI Qualification Evaluation:** Evaluates candidate competency, tenure and project relevance against role criteria, calculating a composite match score (0–100).
3. **Pipeline Synchronization:** Records candidate profile, match metrics and AI summary in the talent database.
4. **Conditional Outreach:**
   - **Score $\ge$ 75 (Shortlist):** Sends automated WhatsApp interview invitation to the candidate and fires an internal alert to the HR Telegram channel.
   - **Score $<$ 75 (Reject):** Sends an automated, constructive rejection email, eliminating candidate ghosting while retaining candidate data in the talent pool.

---

## 2. End-to-End Process Architecture

```
[ Application Submission ] ──► [ Extract PDF Text ] ──► [ Normalize Phone Number ]
                                                                 │
                                                                 ▼
[ Telegram HR Channel ] ◄── [ WhatsApp Invite ] ◄── [ Score >= 75 ] ◄── [ AI Screening Model ]
                                                         │                      │
                                                         ▼                      ▼
                                                  [ Score < 75 ]        [ Recruiter CRM ]
                                                         │
                                                         ▼
                                                [ Rejection Notice ]
```

---

## 3. Workflow Nodes & Data Flow

| Node | Name | Type | Operational Function |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | `Webhook Ingestion` | `n8n-nodes-base.webhook` | Ingests multipart candidate payload (Full Name, Email, Phone, Target Role, PDF CV). |
| **2** | `Extract PDF Text` | `n8n-nodes-base.extractFromFile` | Parses binary PDF file buffer and extracts raw text contents. |
| **3** | `Data Cleaning & Normalization` | `n8n-nodes-base.code` | Cleans non-digits and standardizes Indonesian phone numbers (`08xx` $\rightarrow$ `628xx`). |
| **4** | `AI Screening Model` | `@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.openAi` / `HTTP` | Evaluates qualifications against JD, returning JSON match score and recruiter summary. |
| **5** | `Sync Recruiter CRM` | `n8n-nodes-base.airtable` / `Database` | Appends candidate profile, score and reasoning to the pipeline table. |
| **6** | `Decision Switch` | `n8n-nodes-base.switch` | Evaluates condition: `match_score >= 75`. |
| **7** | `Send WA Interview Invite` | `n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest` | Triggers WhatsApp Gateway API to dispatch interview scheduling link. |
| **8** | `Telegram Recruiter Alert` | `n8n-nodes-base.telegram` | Posts real-time candidate summary to the internal recruitment team group. |
| **9** | `Send Rejection Email` | `n8n-nodes-base.emailSend` | Sends polite closure email informing candidate of talent pool retention. |

---

## 4. Orchestration Workflows

The repository provides two production-ready workflow implementations located in the [`workflows/`](file:///Users/sarifmubdijantika/Documents/cv-scanner/workflows/) directory:

1. **[Production Cloud Workflow](file:///Users/sarifmubdijantika/Documents/cv-scanner/workflows/ai_hr_screening_production.json)**:
   - Uses OpenAI (`gpt-4o-mini`), Airtable CRM, Fonnte WhatsApp Gateway and Telegram Bot API.
2. **[100% Free-Tier Local Workflow](file:///Users/sarifmubdijantika/Documents/cv-scanner/workflows/ai_hr_screening_local_free.json)**:
   - Uses local webhook endpoints and the built-in local screening engine with zero external API costs.

---

## 5. Candidate Journey & SLA Metrics

* **Time-to-Screen:** Instantaneous (< 2 seconds computational time).
* **Communication SLA:** Candidate receives WhatsApp or Email feedback in **< 2 minutes** from submission.
* **Recruiter Notification:** Team receives instant Telegram notification with complete AI candidate brief.
* **Zero Ghosting Assurance:** 100% of candidate submissions receive structured feedback and status updates.

files.README.md:
# 🤖 Automated AI HR Candidate Screening & WhatsApp Nurturing System

![n8n](https://img.shields.io/badge/n8n-Workflow%20Orchestrator-FF6D5A?style=for-the-badge&logo=n8n&logoColor=white)
![AI Engine](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI-Semantic%20Screening-412991?style=for-the-badge&logo=openai&logoColor=white)
![WhatsApp](https://img.shields.io/badge/WhatsApp-Gateway%20Nurturing-25D366?style=for-the-badge&logo=whatsapp&logoColor=white)
![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-Internal%20HR%20Alerts-229ED9?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)
![Local Free Tier](https://img.shields.io/badge/Local%20Engine-100%25%20Free%20Tier-success?style=for-the-badge)

An automated, intelligent talent screening and candidate engagement pipeline powered by **n8n orchestration**. The system ingests candidate applications, extracts resume text from PDF documents, evaluates role-specific qualifications using AI semantic scoring and instantly triggers personalized **WhatsApp interview invitations** and **Telegram recruiter alerts** in **< 2 minutes**.

> 📚 **Complete Setup & Configuration Walkthrough:**  
> For detailed step-by-step instructions on setting up corporate WhatsApp API, importing n8n workflows and testing the flow with screenshots, please see the [**System Setup & Configuration Guide**](SETUP_AND_CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md).

---

## ⚡ n8n Orchestration Architecture & Workflow Flow

The core recruitment pipeline is orchestrated via n8n, handling data extraction, schema normalization, AI evaluation, database synchronization and conditional communication dispatch.

![n8n Orchestration Workflow Canvas](docs/images/n8n_workflow_canvas.png)

### 📌 Node-by-Node Pipeline Execution

| Node # | Node Name | Node Type / Protocol | Operational Function |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | `Webhook Ingestion` | `n8n-nodes-base.webhook` | Ingests multipart candidate payload (Full Name, Indonesian Phone, Email, Target Position, Binary PDF CV). |
| **2** | `Extract CV Text (PDF)` | `n8n-nodes-base.extractFromFile` | Extracts and parses the text layer from the uploaded resume file. |
| **3** | `Clean Phone & Format Data` | `n8n-nodes-base.code` | Normalizes localized Indonesian phone inputs (`08xx` → international format `628xx`). |
| **4** | `AI Screening Model` | `@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.openAi` / `HTTP` | Evaluates qualification match against Job Description, generating a 0–100 score, key skills and recruiter reasoning. |
| **5** | `Sync to Airtable CRM` | `n8n-nodes-base.airtable` / Local DB | Records candidate profile, match metrics and AI summary to the talent pipeline. |
| **6** | `Switch (Score >= 75)` | `n8n-nodes-base.switch` | Logical branching: routes shortlisted candidates (≥ 75) vs rejected candidates (< 75). |
| **7** | `Send WA Interview Invite` | `n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest` | Dispatches instant WhatsApp interview booking invitation via WhatsApp API Gateway. |
| **8** | `Telegram Internal HR Alert` | `n8n-nodes-base.telegram` | Sends candidate brief & score summary to the internal recruitment team group chat. |
| **9** | `Send Rejection Email` | `n8n-nodes-base.emailSend` | Sends polite, constructive feedback email confirming talent pool storage (zero ghosting). |

---

## 🎯 AI Scoring Parameters & Evaluation Rubric

The candidate qualification scoring model evaluates applications on a **0–100 weighted index** across 3 distinct parameter dimensions:

```
                      ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
                      │    TOTAL MATCH SCORE (0–100 Pts)       │
                      └───────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                                          │
             ┌────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┐
             ▼                            ▼                           ▼
  [ Technical Skills (50%) ]  [ Experience Tenure (30%) ]  [ Domain Relevance (20%) ]
  - Required Skills (85 pts)  - >= 4 yrs / Senior (95 pts) - Work History (+8 pts)
  - Preferred Bonus (15 pts)  - 2-3 yrs / Mid     (85 pts) - Education    (+7 pts)
                              - 1 yr / Junior     (75 pts) - Portfolio    (+10 pts)
                              - < 1 yr            (60 pts)
```

### 1. Technical & Core Skills Match (50% Weight)
* **Mandatory Requirements (85% sub-weight):** Exact & semantic match against role-critical tech stack and competencies (e.g., React, TypeScript, Next.js, Redux, REST API, Git).
* **Preferred / Nice-to-Have Bonus (15% sub-weight):** Bonus points for complementary skills (e.g., GraphQL, CI/CD, Jest, Docker, UI/UX).
* **Formula:** $\text{Skills Score} = \left(\frac{\text{Matched Required}}{\text{Total Required}} \times 85\right) + \left(\frac{\text{Matched Preferred}}{\text{Total Preferred}} \times 15\right)$

### 2. Experience Tenure & Seniority Alignment (30% Weight)
* **Tenure Extraction:** Natural language regex and semantic pattern matching across employment timelines (`X years of experience`, `Senior/Lead`, `Mid`, `Junior/Intern`).
* **Scoring Rubric:**
  * **$\ge 4$ Years / Senior Lead:** $95\text{ pts}$
  * **$2 - 3$ Years / Mid-Level:** $85\text{ pts}$
  * **$1$ Year / Junior Associate:** $75\text{ pts}$
  * **$< 1$ Year / Fresh Graduate:** $60 - 65\text{ pts}$

### 3. Structural & Domain Relevance (20% Weight)
* **Work Experience Evidence:** Structured past role descriptions and achievements ($+8\text{ pts}$).
* **Academic Background:** Degree accreditation in relevant fields ($+7\text{ pts}$).
* **Project / Portfolio Evidence:** Verified GitHub, live web deployments or portfolio links ($+10\text{ pts}$).

### ⚖️ Decision Rule & Routing Threshold:
$$\text{Final Score} = (\text{Skills Score} \times 0.50) + (\text{Experience Score} \times 0.30) + (\text{Relevance Score} \times 0.20)$$

* **Score $\ge 75$ (SHORTLIST):** Triggers candidate WhatsApp interview invite + Telegram recruiter alert.
* **Score $< 75$ (REJECT):** Triggers polite rejection email and retains profile in talent pool.

---

## 🧪 Candidate Screening & Automated Routing Flow

```json
  "email": "budi.santoso@techcorp.id",
```

* **Telegram Internal Recruiter Alert (Includes Internal Evaluation Score & Brief):**

---

## 📱 WhatsApp API Integration & Corporate Number Setup

The automated WhatsApp message dispatch can be configured to connect directly with your official company WhatsApp number.

### 1. How the WhatsApp Automation Operates
1. **Automated Trigger:** When a candidate is screened with a score $\ge$ 75, the workflow instantly calls the WhatsApp Gateway API endpoint.
2. **Device Routing:** The Gateway authenticates via your API Token and routes the message through your linked corporate WhatsApp device (scanned via QR Code).
3. **Delivery:** The candidate receives the interview invitation on their WhatsApp within seconds without any recruiter manual clicking.

### 2. Configuration Setup

Create a `.env` file in the root directory:

```env
PORT=3000

# WhatsApp API Gateway (e.g. Fonnte / WAHA / WhatsApp Cloud API)
FONNTE_API_TOKEN=your_corporate_fonnte_token_here

# Telegram HR Internal Channel (Optional for cloud alerts)
TELEGRAM_HR_BOT_TOKEN=your_telegram_bot_token
TELEGRAM_HR_CHAT_ID=-1001234567890

# OpenAI API Key (Optional: system uses built-in zero-cost engine if omitted)
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-xxxx...
```

#### Steps to Link Corporate WhatsApp:
1. Register/Login to your WhatsApp Gateway provider (e.g., [Fonnte](https://fonnte.com)).
2. Scan the QR Code with your corporate WhatsApp number to pair the device.
3. Copy your API Token and paste it as `FONNTE_API_TOKEN` in `.env` or in n8n's **Node 7 (`Send WA Interview Invite`)** header:
   ```json
   {
     "Authorization": "={{ $env.FONNTE_API_TOKEN }}"
   }
   ```
4. Once configured, every shortlisted candidate application automatically receives the WhatsApp invitation directly to their phone.

## 🧪 Performance Benchmarks & Stress Test Analysis

The system includes an automated stress testing and latency benchmarking suite to validate high-throughput candidate ingestion under heavy requisition loads.

```bash
# Run benchmark with 250 candidate resumes (Concurrency: 10)
npm run stress-test -- 250
```

### 📈 Empirical Benchmark Results (Batch Size: 250 Resumes)

| Metric | Measured Value | Operational Significance |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Total Batch Processing Time** | **0.38 seconds** | Complete ingestion, PDF text parsing and scoring for 250 applications in $< 1\text{s}$. |
| **System Throughput** | **654.95 resumes/sec** | Equivalent to $\approx 39,297$ resumes/minute capacity. |
| **Average Latency per Resume** | **10.05 ms** | Sub-second evaluation ensures instant candidate feedback loops. |
| **P50 (Median Latency)** | **7.84 ms** | 50% of candidate resumes processed in $< 8\text{ms}$. |
| **P95 Latency** | **21.41 ms** | 95% of candidates evaluated in $< 22\text{ms}$. |
| **P99 Latency** | **56.82 ms** | Tail latency remains well under $60\text{ms}$ even under high concurrency. |
| **Memory Delta** | **46.83 MB** | Ultra-lightweight footprint suitable for low-cost VPS and free-tier hosting. |

### 📐 Mathematical Projection Model (Why Screening Drops from 15–20 hrs to < 1 hr)

The projection is derived from empirical workload modeling comparing traditional human screening versus the AI-assisted pipeline:

$$\text{Manual Screening Baseline} = N_{\text{resumes}} \times T_{\text{manual}}$$
$$\text{AI-Assisted Recruiter Effort} = (N_{\text{resumes}} \times R_{\text{shortlist}} \times T_{\text{verify}}) + T_{\text{audit}}$$

* **Assumptions:**
  * **Weekly Applicant Volume ($N$):** $250\text{ resumes/week}$ across open requisitions.
  * **Manual Review Speed ($T_{\text{manual}}$):** Industry standard baseline of **$4.0\text{ mins/resume}$** (opening PDF, parsing skills/experience, checking requirement match, logging to CRM, drafting email/WhatsApp).
  * **Shortlist Filter Pass Rate ($R_{\text{shortlist}}$):** Top **$20\%$ qualified candidates** ($\approx 50\text{ candidates}$).
  * **Recruiter Verification ($T_{\text{verify}}$):** **$1.0\text{ min/shortlisted candidate}$** (glancing over AI score card before interview).
  * **Weekly Spot-Check Audit ($T_{\text{audit}}$):** **$5\text{ minutes/week}$** for margin of safety.

$$\text{Manual Time} = 250 \times 4.0\text{ mins} = 1,000\text{ mins } (\mathbf{16.7\text{ hours/week}})$$
$$\text{AI-Assisted Recruiter Time} = (50 \times 1.0\text{ min}) + 5\text{ mins} = 55\text{ mins } (\mathbf{0.92\text{ hours/week}})$$
$$\text{Net Time Saved} = 16.7\text{ hrs} - 0.92\text{ hrs} = \mathbf{15.8\text{ hours/week saved (94.5\% Reduction)}}$$

## 1. System Architecture Overview

The system automates candidate ingestion, resume parsing, multi-dimensional qualification scoring, database sync and conditional outreach (WhatsApp for Shortlisted candidates and polite closure email for Rejected candidates).

![n8n Orchestration Canvas](docs/images/n8n_workflow_canvas.png)

```
[ Candidate Application (PDF CV) ]
               │
               ▼
[ 1. Webhook Ingestion ] ──► [ 2. PDF Text Extraction ] ──► [ 3. Phone Normalizer ]
                                                                     │
                                                                     ▼
[ Telegram HR Alert ] ◄── [ WA Invite ] ◄── [ Score >= 75 ] ◄── [ 4. AI Screening Engine ]
                                                   │                         │
                                                   ▼                         ▼
                                            [ Score < 75 ]            [ 5. Recruiter CRM ]
                                                   │
                                                   ▼
```

```bash
cd cv-scanner

npm install
```

## 3. Connecting Corporate WhatsApp API (Fonnte)

The system is engineered to automatically dispatch personalized interview invitations from your **official corporate WhatsApp number** whenever a candidate achieves a match score $\ge 75$.

### Step 1: Register & Pair Device
1. Visit [Fonnte WhatsApp Gateway](https://fonnte.com) and create an account.
2. Navigate to **Device / Manage Device**.
3. Scan the generated **QR Code** using your company WhatsApp mobile application (*Settings* → *Linked Devices*).
4. Copy your **API Token / Secret Key** from the Fonnte dashboard.

### Step 2: Configure Environment File
Create a `.env` file in the project root (copy from `.env.example`):

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

Add your token to `.env`:
```env
PORT=3000
FONNTE_API_TOKEN=your_fonnte_token_here
```

### Step 3: Automated Behavior
- **Automatic Dispatch:** When a candidate is screened with Score $\ge 75$, `server.js` automatically fires a background `POST https://api.fonnte.com/send` request, sending the WhatsApp message straight to the candidate's phone.
- **Direct Click-to-Chat Fallback:** If running in offline test mode without an API key, the platform provides direct `https://wa.me/...` links so recruiters can preview or send with 1 click.

## 4. Setting Up n8n Workflow Automation

If you are running your own **n8n** instance (Cloud or Self-Hosted), you can import the pre-built workflows directly:

### Available Workflow Blueprints:
* **Production Cloud Workflow:** [`workflows/ai_hr_screening_production.json`](workflows/ai_hr_screening_production.json)
  - Uses OpenAI (`gpt-4o-mini`), Airtable CRM, Fonnte Gateway and Telegram Bot API.
* **100% Free-Tier Local Workflow:** [`workflows/ai_hr_screening_local_free.json`](workflows/ai_hr_screening_local_free.json)
  - Connects to local webhook endpoints and the offline semantic engine.

### How to Import into n8n:
1. Open your n8n workspace dashboard.
2. Click **Workflows** → **Add Workflow** → **Import from File...**
3. Select `workflows/ai_hr_screening_production.json`.
4. In **Node 7 (`Send WA Interview Invite`)**, ensure the `Authorization` header is set to your `FONNTE_API_TOKEN`:
   ```json
   {
     "name": "Authorization",
     "value": "={{ $env.FONNTE_API_TOKEN }}"
   }
   ```
5. Click **Save** and toggle the workflow to **Active**.

## 💡 Troubleshooting & FAQ

* **Q: Can I run this system completely offline for free?**  
  *A: Yes! By default, the system runs with the built-in local heuristic and semantic engine with zero API keys required.*
* **Q: Why are internal scores not shown in the candidate WhatsApp message?**  
  *A: Best practices in recruitment UX dictate that candidates receive a polite and motivating invitation, while numeric scoring ($94/100$) is kept strictly for internal recruiter review.*
* **Q: How do I test with my own resume?**  
  *A: Drag and drop your `.pdf` CV into the dropzone on the **Test Screening** tab, enter your contact information and click **Run AI Qualification Screening*.*
